notes: Shipped registry. File paths are relative to this folder and point into the Protoboard Stack repository (design/brand and packages/ext-docs/fonts); they are not copied into this package, so in an installed copy without the repository these entries resolve as not verified and a user or project registers its own files. The hashes were taken from the files on 2026-11-12.
